---
title: "Sleep Quality Classification"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
tidymodels_prefer()
```

## Load data

```{r}
set.seed(1821)

data_path <- file.path("data", "sleep_dataset.csv")
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("Missing data/sleep_dataset.csv")
}

sleep_data <- read.csv(data_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), factor))

if (!"Q15" %in% names(sleep_data)) {
  stop("Expected sleep-quality target column Q15.")
}

sleep_data <- sleep_data %>% filter(!is.na(Q15))
table(sleep_data$Q15)
```

## Basic data quality

```{r}
data_quality <- tibble(
  variable = names(sleep_data),
  missing = vapply(sleep_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)), numeric(1)),
  unique_values = vapply(sleep_data, function(x) length(unique(x)), numeric(1))
)
data_quality
```

## Stratified hold-out split

```{r}
set.seed(1821)
sleep_split <- initial_split(sleep_data, prop = 0.75, strata = Q15)
sleep_train <- training(sleep_split)
```

## Leakage-safe preprocessing and model

All learned preprocessing is part of the workflow, so it is re-estimated inside each cross-validation fold and never fitted on the held-out test partition.

```{r}
sleep_recipe <- recipe(Q15 ~ ., data = sleep_train) %>%
  step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "unknown") %>%
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors(), new_level = "new") %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors())

rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = 1000,
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(sleep_recipe) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

set.seed(1821)
folds <- vfold_cv(sleep_train, v = 5, strata = Q15)

parameters <- extract_parameter_set_dials(rf_workflow) %>%
  finalize(sleep_train)

set.seed(1821)
grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(parameters, size = 15)

set.seed(1821)
tuning <- tune_grid(
  rf_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap)
)

collect_metrics(tuning)
```

## Held-out evaluation

```{r}
best_parameters <- select_best(tuning, metric = "accuracy")
final_workflow <- finalize_workflow(rf_workflow, best_parameters)

set.seed(1821)
final_fit <- last_fit(
  final_workflow,
  split = sleep_split,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap)
)

collect_metrics(final_fit)
heldout_predictions <- collect_predictions(final_fit)
conf_mat(heldout_predictions, truth = Q15, estimate = .pred_class)
```

## Scope

This is an exploratory sleep-quality classification project. It is not a clinical diagnostic tool.
